purpose: correctness shadow: the same complete HostLab audit over the reference engine (A) and MeguvizDexDash (B), compared; no timing claim

reference.driver: HostLab analyze.main audit --mode full, unmodified; B replaces only native_session and install_dexsql

B.note: the binary is whatever the local build is; its sha256, build id and pin are written into every run record

resources.note: limits for both sides alike; a side that exceeds them fails closed and is recorded, it is not given more within the same attempt. Raised from 8 GiB after attempt 1 (see attempts).

never: publishing an artifact as a result
changing a completed-cache of the primary

ignore_list: conformance/hostlab/compare_full_reports.py IGNORE_LIST (mdd.hostlab-shadow-ignore.v1 v1): engine identity and clocks only
performance: not measured; wall times in the records are not a measurement and no exclusive window was used

attempts.observed: the engine process exited during the open of the dataset (exit status 3221226505) with 'memory allocation of 12731520 bytes failed'; Job peak commit 8601247744 bytes, 13 s; the harness recorded the side as incomplete and compared nothing
attempts.reading: Dataset::open builds the facts of every selected DEX when the session opens, so the open needs memory for the whole APK; side A (DexSQL) peaked at 1572528128 bytes on the same input
attempts.action: the limit for both sides alike is raised to 14 GiB; no other limit and no engine budget is changed

attempts.observed: the engine process exited during the open of the dataset (exit status 3221226505) with 'memory allocation of 7077888 bytes failed'; Job peak commit 15039139840 bytes (the limit), 28 s; the side was recorded as incomplete and compared with nothing
attempts.reading: Dataset::open (contract dialect) builds metadata, definitions, code, annotation and reference facts of every one of the 33 selected DEX in turn and keeps all of them for the session; on this input that does not fit in 14 GiB. Side A (DexSQL) peaked at 1572528128 bytes on the same input
attempts.action: the limit is not raised again on this machine (31.8 GiB in all, about 8 GiB free when tried): a larger run needs either a machine kept free for it or an engine that builds layers on demand. Nothing in the engine, the budgets or the comparison was changed to make the run pass
